Each is spurious.'), and causal_review::audit_controls re-tests them with a measured factor but writes nothing, retracts nothing and moves no size (causal_review.rs:32-38; platform.rs:9882-9887). What does exist and is applied in production is an uncertainty record on each written edge: confidence is capped at TEMPORAL_PRECEDENCE_CONFIDENCE_CEILING = 0.5 (granger.rs:87), and a caller that names an unobserved confounder gets a Suggestive edge with a lower ceiling (confounder.rs:70-78; causal.rs:328-345). No production caller names one. There is no EffectAttribution type and no action-policy weight anywhere in the tree.
